tex_content.html:
\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Harmonic diffeomorphism near an approximate isometry] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0293 ↗ prop:chow-iv-harmonic-diffeomorphism-negative-ricci 1. ch34:34.18\group Harmonic Maps with Boundary

An approximate isometry between compact manifolds satisfying the negative Ricci-curvature and concave-boundary hypotheses can, when sufficiently close, be followed by a harmonic diffeomorphism close to it and satisfying the normal boundary condition. \end{claim}
